title: Household Add-On Membership: notice required before a voluntary removal
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the notice the primary member must give before a voluntary removal of the dependent takes effect, expressed as the cancellation-notice basis and the removal-notice basis (the two figures may be equal for a given tier).

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Cancellation notice | Removal notice |
|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Dependent Child Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Young Adult Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Senior Parent Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Household Multi-Add-On | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |

## Points of judgement
- Every current tier sets both notice figures at zero calendar days, meaning a primary member's voluntary removal of a dependent under any tier of the Household Add-On Membership may take effect without any waiting period being counted against the primary member.
- The two notice figures are recorded separately for each tier because they need not always coincide; today they read the same value for every tier, but each is its own basis and could diverge by tier under a future notice table.
